notes.title: For anyone who is experiencing stuttering/fps drops
notes.content:
If the problem begins right after the patch on 7/17/2020, then you may switch back to the stable build on 6/27. Just open the game properties, and click "stable". It will be automatically downloaded for you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36604826/5fd9307bc481daaedfe79b41def40abe07b234bc.png[/img]

If you have such issue, please leave a comment and let me know about:
[list]
[*]your hardware spec (including your keyboard, mouse, and controller)
[*]OS and GPU driver version
[*]if you use a controller in this game
[*]did you encounter any stutter in the "map editing" mode.
[*]anything else that may be relevant to this issue
[/list]
